manifest.description: A plugin that integrates PayPal's APIs and MCP server into your development workflow. Get AI-assisted help with PayPal payments, subscriptions, invoices, disputes, and more — directly in your editor/terminal.
manifest.name: paypal

hooks.prompt: This hook is informational only and must never block or deny an edit. Look at the file path and content being written. If, and only if, the file is source code (not JSON, YAML, or Markdown) and the change touches PayPal SDK, API, checkout, or payment integration logic, remind the assistant that the paypal-best-practices skill has SDK reference docs for v5 (paypal.Buttons, sdk/js?client-id=) and v6 (createInstance, web-sdk/v6/core), and that paypal-routing handles migrations and intent routing. Otherwise, add no extra commentary. Regardless of the file, you must end your response with the single word 'approve' on its own line — this hook always approves and only ever adds optional context.
